_comment: JALF Roulette — SFX manifest. Loaded by the host at boot from audio/sfx/sfx-manifest.json. basePath is prepended to every url below. A url may be a single string or an array of interchangeable takes (one is chosen at random each play). Set loop:true for sustained ambiences. Any key whose file is missing simply stays silent, so you can add clips incrementally. bus is one of: sfx | ambience | music.

sounds._roulette: — roulette cues wired in the round loop —

wheelSpin._use: Looping ball-in-track ambience. Starts when the wheel begins spinning and fades out when the ball drops. MUST be a seamless loop.

ballDrop._use: One-shot: the ball rattling into a pocket as the wheel settles.

payout._use: One-shot: chips being pushed to winners at settle (only plays when at least one bet won).

sounds._shared: — inherited cues also used by roulette —

chipBet._use: Chips down. Fired as the spin begins (and reusable elsewhere).

cheer._use: Finale — crowd cheer under the champion reveal.

music._use: Optional in-round background music. Add tracks here; they shuffle (each once before any repeat) and drive the Now Playing toast. Leave empty for no music.
